factors: MOF candidate × formaldehyde feed × water phase
factorsZh: MOF 候选物 × 甲醛投料 × 水相
reason: Most directly tests formic-acid priority under the target path.
reasonZh: 最直接检验目标路径下的甲酸优先级。
suggestedValidation: Run carbon balance and NaH13CO3 isotope tracing.
suggestedValidationZh: 执行碳平衡与 NaH13CO3 同位素示踪。

factors: functional group × glyceraldehyde feed × C2 leakage
factorsZh: 官能团 × 甘油醛投料 × C2 泄漏
reason: Needed before claiming suppression of competing pathway.
reasonZh: 在声称抑制竞争路径前必须补齐。
suggestedValidation: Add glyceraldehyde feeding and product time-series analysis.
suggestedValidationZh: 补充甘油醛投料和产物时间序列分析。

factors: metal node × water stability × reaction duration
factorsZh: 金属节点 × 水稳定性 × 反应时长
reason: Stability can invalidate an otherwise favorable catalytic hypothesis.
reasonZh: 稳定性可能推翻原本有利的催化假设。
suggestedValidation: Post-reaction PXRD, ICP leaching and uptake retention.
suggestedValidationZh: 反应后 PXRD、ICP 浸出和吸附保持率检查。

factors: reaction condition × evidence type × candidate priority
factorsZh: 反应条件 × 证据类型 × 候选优先级
reason: Controls whether literature evidence is comparable enough for ranking.
reasonZh: 决定文献证据是否足以支撑排序比较。
suggestedValidation: Mini design across pH, feed ratio and residence time.
suggestedValidationZh: 围绕 pH、投料比例和停留时间做小型设计。
